name: Motion Carousel
purpose: A 5-6 slide social carousel where each slide is a short motion clip instead of a static image.

alternate_canvas.note: feed-shaped variant only when a job explicitly asks for it

canonical_canvas.note: CONFIRMED in the Phase 2A refinement: the canonical Motion Carousel production canvas is 1080x1920. The Static Ultra Carousel stays 1080x1350 and is a different format.

fold_editions.rule: Each slide is RECOMPOSED for the wider canvas - media and text become two zones instead of a vertical stack. Never a crop of the 9:16 slide. Every profile still exports each slide as its own MP4.

canvas_profiles_source: brand/tokens/adel-v2.1.json -> canvasProfiles. Dimensions are configuration read from a profile; this file must not hold a canvas assumption once the engine reads profiles.
slide_rule: 5-6 independently exportable video slides, ~5s each, genuine motion/video composition - never animated static zooms.
